ops.name: Plan the system (airframe + avionics architecture, interfaces, budgets)
Partial PART SOURCING — resolve IC/connector/fastener BOM via parts library and/or ecad_find_part;
SCHERMATIC — ecad_new_schematic / place / WIRE nets (ecad_connect / net tools) so the netlist has simulatable devices before SPICE.
SPICE — ecad_simulate OP on the wired 3V3 front-end; measure V(3V3).
PCB LAYOUT + TRACE OPT — REQUIRED chain: board_from_schematic → ecad_optimize_traces → ecad_run_drc (errors==0 or honest FAIL).
ANTEenna/RF — ecad_antenna_design + analyze for 2.4 GHz IFA and GPS patch;
FWirmware — fw_new_project(stm32f4) + pinmap from netlist + fw_build.
RENODE SENSOR-IN-THE-LOOP — climb_turn_profile → fw_sensor_scenario → fw_sim_run + fw_verify_board; SKIP honestly if Renode absent.

MECHANICAL — model the rocket-plane airframe as editable CAD with verify_battery PASS: body tube ~OD 40–60mm length ≥300mm, 3–4 fins, wing/glide surface, closed payload bay volume ≥ board envelope; use sketch+extrude/revolve + fillets; avoid zero-thickness and open shells.
DELIVERABLE — consolidate mission report card (PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP per leg) and power_budget rollup.
